webGuide.title: Platform guide
webGuide.welcomeBody: Your personal space is ready. Explore the platform, create a key, and experience memory through a conversation.

webGuide.space.title: Your personal space
webGuide.space.body: This is your current workspace. Memories, keys and conversations belong to the selected space. You can also switch spaces here.
webGuide.quickstart.title: Quickstart
webGuide.quickstart.body: Use the sidebar to open API keys, Chat and Memories. Return here whenever you want to connect an Agent or use the code examples.
webGuide.key.title: Create an API key
webGuide.key.body: An API key lets this space access the memory service. Click Create and give it a name, or continue with an existing usable key.
webGuide.key.wait: Create a key to continue. You do not need to paste it into the chat.
webGuide.chat.title: Experience memory
webGuide.chat.body: Tell the assistant something you want it to remember, then ask about it in a new conversation.
webGuide.chat.follow: Follow the chat guide to save and recall information, then explore the memory details.
webGuide.memory.title: Memories and versions
webGuide.memory.body: Conversations and memories are different. Click the eye icon (Details) on a memory to open it, then switch to the Memory versions tab to see how it changed.
webGuide.memory.wait: One more step: switch to the Memory versions tab in the details panel to continue.
webGuide.memory.drawerHint: Guide: click the Memory versions tab above to see how this memory changed.

webGuide.logs.title: Request logs
webGuide.logs.body: View requests and their results for this space. The chat memory log shows retrievals, saves and updates. Explore the other features from the sidebar.

quickstart.agentCode.title: Integrate with your coding Agent
quickstart.agentCode.desc: Send this prompt to Cursor, Claude Code or another coding assistant to integrate the selected example.
quickstart.agentCode.prompt:
Integrate Graph Memory into this project using {0}. Inspect the project first and follow its existing language and configuration conventions. The examples below contain the write and search APIs; use them to generate the integration. Read the key from GRAPH_MEMORY_API_KEY; never put it in source code or logs. YOUR_API_KEY is a placeholder; remind me to configure it locally. Submitted conversations take time to become memories; keep the guidance to retry later if a search is empty. Report changed files, how to run the integration and actual verification results.

{1}
